$comment: GX-9000 fleet comms protocol — binding for all agents on all nodes. Established 2026-08-28 after raul outage (blaster died via session-kill; restored with linger) and phone onboarding (SSH publickey dead-ends; blaster worked instantly).

blaster.rule: ALWAYS FIRST. Never skip. Never go straight to SSH.

ssh.rule: ONLY after blaster fails twice. Log the failover in your session notes. Plain LAN SSH is not part of the fleet.

health_rules.blaster_down: check user service + enable linger (loginctl enable-linger <user>) — blaster must survive logouts/reboots
health_rules.node_unreachable: ping tailscale IP first, then blaster retry, THEN consider ssh rescue
health_rules.after_any_gdm_or_session_restart: verify blaster returns — session restarts kill user managers
